subject: [PATCH 5/6] memcg: group the read-mostly fields of struct mem_cgroup

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch groups the read-mostly fields of struct mem_cgroup together at the end of the structure, reducing false sharing between these fields and improving cache performance. The fields grouped include vmstats_percpu, vmstats, zswap_max, private_id, kmemcg_id, and oom_group. This change does not introduce any functional changes but optimizes memory access patterns. The grouping is done using a cacheline group boundary, which ensures that these fields are stored in the same cache line as nodeinfo[].
